name: usrcp-stream
description: Cross-surface conversation layer for USRCP - encrypted local capture, embeddings, thread stitching, active-surface presence

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); for (const p of [\"node_modules/better-sqlite3/build\",\"node_modules/usrcp-local/node_modules/better-sqlite3/build\",\"node_modules/usrcp-stream/node_modules/better-sqlite3/build\"]) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm rebuild better-sqlite3
scripts.pretest: (cd ../usrcp-local && npm run build) && (cd ../usrcp-cloud && npm run build)

author: USRCP Contributors
